name: Resident Evil Outbreak — Modern Camera
author: RaccoonRecomp
description:
Over-the-shoulder camera for the US release (SLUS-20765 v2.00), ported from Snippy's Outbreak ModernCam (made for the Japanese discs; heysnippy.com). Right-stick and mouse look, Main/Aim/Alt framings, free gun elevation, walking while aiming, crosshair, reload, sprint and shoot buttons, camera collision and room-cut matching.

It needs the game's mod runtime, the host services of HOST_API.md and the game code built with this mod's patches.json (Build-Game with the feature profile). Ask Snippy before publishing it.

settings.label: Modern Camera
settings.description: Over-the-shoulder camera (the exe's Start/Stop). Off hands the camera and everything else back to the game.

settings.label: Distance
settings.description: How far behind her the camera sits.

settings.label: Left / Right
settings.description: Sideways offset. Positive = over her right shoulder, negative = left. Swap Shoulder writes the new side here.

settings.label: Height
settings.description: Raises the camera and the point it looks at together, so the view moves up or down without tilting.

settings.label: Field of View
settings.description: Vertical field of view in degrees (the exe: 30-90). 0 keeps each room's own FOV.

settings.label: Look Drop
settings.description: How far below its own height the camera looks: a fixed downward framing tilt (the exe keeps it out of its window).

settings.label: Pitch Trim
settings.description: Constant up/down tilt added to the camera's orbit pitch.

settings.label: Aim: Custom Distance
settings.description: On: the aim camera (blended in while aiming) uses its own distance below. Off: it follows the main camera's.

settings.label: Aim: Distance
settings.description: How far behind her the camera sits. Applies while Aim: Custom Distance is on.

settings.label: Aim: Custom Left / Right
settings.description: On: the aim camera (blended in while aiming) uses its own left / right below. Off: it follows the main camera's.

settings.label: Aim: Left / Right
settings.description: Sideways offset, + = her right shoulder. Applies while Aim: Custom Left / Right is on.

settings.label: Aim: Custom Height
settings.description: On: the aim camera (blended in while aiming) uses its own height below. Off: it follows the main camera's.

settings.label: Aim: Height
settings.description: Lifts the camera and its look point together. Applies while Aim: Custom Height is on.

settings.label: Aim: Custom Field of View
settings.description: On: the aim camera (blended in while aiming) uses its own field of view below. Off: it follows the main camera's.

settings.label: Aim: Field of View
settings.description: Vertical field of view. 0 keeps the room's own FOV. Applies while Aim: Custom Field of View is on.

settings.label: Aim: Custom Look Drop
settings.description: On: the aim camera (blended in while aiming) uses its own look drop below. Off: it follows the main camera's.

settings.label: Aim: Look Drop
settings.description: How far below its own height the camera looks. Applies while Aim: Custom Look Drop is on.

settings.label: Aim: Custom Pitch Trim
settings.description: On: the aim camera (blended in while aiming) uses its own pitch trim below. Off: it follows the main camera's.

settings.label: Aim: Pitch Trim
settings.description: Constant tilt added to the orbit pitch. Applies while Aim: Custom Pitch Trim is on.

settings.label: Alt: Custom Distance

settings.label: Alt: Distance

settings.label: Alt: Custom Left / Right
settings.description: On: the Alt View camera uses its own left / right below. Off: it follows the main camera's.

settings.label: Alt: Left / Right
settings.description: Sideways offset, + = her right shoulder. Applies while Alt: Custom Left / Right is on.

settings.label: Alt: Custom Height
settings.description: On: the Alt View camera uses its own height below. Off: it follows the main camera's.

settings.label: Alt: Height
settings.description: Lifts the camera and its look point together. Applies while Alt: Custom Height is on.

settings.label: Alt: Custom Field of View
settings.description: On: the Alt View camera uses its own field of view below. Off: it follows the main camera's.

settings.label: Alt: Field of View
settings.description: Vertical field of view. 0 keeps the room's own FOV. Applies while Alt: Custom Field of View is on.

settings.label: Alt: Custom Look Drop
settings.description: On: the Alt View camera uses its own look drop below. Off: it follows the main camera's.

settings.label: Alt: Look Drop
settings.description: How far below its own height the camera looks. Applies while Alt: Custom Look Drop is on.

settings.label: Alt: Custom Pitch Trim
settings.description: On: the Alt View camera uses its own pitch trim below. Off: it follows the main camera's.

settings.label: Alt: Pitch Trim
settings.description: Constant tilt added to the orbit pitch. Applies while Alt: Custom Pitch Trim is on.

settings.label: Keep Behind Character
settings.description: On (the exe's 'follow'): the camera swings back behind her as she moves. Off ('manual', ModernCam's File 1 default): it stays wherever you leave it.

settings.label: Follow Speed
settings.description: How quickly the camera swings behind her (Keep Behind Character on).

settings.label: Recenter Speed
settings.description: Seconds for a look with the right stick or mouse to ease back behind her (Keep Behind Character on). 0 never releases it.

settings.label: Sensitivity (gamepad)
settings.description: Turn speed in degrees per second at full right-stick push.

settings.label: Sensitivity (keyboard & mouse)
settings.description: Degrees per mouse count x 0.4, as the exe. Raw mouse motion, no acceleration.

settings.label: Lock Look to the Gun
settings.description: While aiming, stop the camera tilting further than the gun can follow.

settings.label: Aim Sensitivity
settings.description: Look speed multiplier while aiming.

settings.label: Gun Elevation
settings.description: How far up and down the gun can point, in degrees.

settings.label: Crosshair
settings.description: Show a crosshair while aiming (drawn by REO over the game picture).

settings.label: Crosshair Size
settings.description: Pixels: the dot's radius or the cross's arm length.

settings.label: Crosshair Gap
settings.description: Pixels between the centre and each arm (Cross only).

settings.label: Crosshair Thickness
settings.description: Pixels (Cross only).

settings.label: Steered By
settings.description: auto (Gamepad: the most active pad), kbm (Keyboard & Mouse) or pad:N (that pad). The camera's own input; the game keeps REO's controls.

settings.label: Aim
settings.description: Hold to aim (ModernCam's File 1 bind: left trigger). With Modern Aim the camera holds R1, the game's aim, for her. On Keyboard & Mouse a pad or trigger bind is the right mouse button.

settings.label: Shoot
settings.description: Fires with whichever button fires under your control type (File 1 bind: right trigger).

settings.label: Reload
settings.description: Reloads the equipped weapon from carried ammo with the game's own reload animation (File 1 bind: X / Square).

settings.label: Sprint (toggle)
settings.description: Sprint without holding the dash button; takes the dash action off its original button (File 1 bind: L3).

settings.label: Free Cursor
settings.description: Keyboard & Mouse: frees or captures the mouse (C).

settings.label: Recenter
settings.description: Snaps the camera behind her.

settings.label: Swap Shoulder
settings.description: Moves the camera to her other shoulder and saves the side (File 1 bind: R3).

settings.label: Special Action
settings.description: While held, presses the dash action's button for the game (the exe's note: for characters whose special move shares the dash button), and keeps the bound button from the game.

settings.label: Watch Next Player
settings.description: Multiplayer only: the camera follows the next human player while you keep control. Offline there is no one else to watch, so it does nothing (online play is not available).

settings.label: Alt View
settings.description: Toggles the Alt rig.

settings.label: Vertical Sensitivity
settings.description: Up/down speed in degrees per second at full right-stick push.

settings.label: Aim Zoom Speed (fallback)
settings.description: Used for zooming in or out when that speed below is 0 (the exe: when it is not set).

settings.label: Aim Zoom In Speed
settings.description: 0 uses the fallback above.

settings.label: Aim Zoom Out Speed
settings.description: 0 uses the fallback above.

settings.label: Follow While Aiming
settings.description: Used when Modern Aim is off.

settings.label: Snap Behind on Aim
settings.description: Pressing aim swings the camera straight behind her (Modern Aim off).

settings.label: Gun Zero
settings.description: Gun elevation when the camera is level.

settings.label: Aim Shoulder Minimum
settings.description: Minimum sideways offset while aiming.

settings.label: Aim Turn Deadzone
settings.description: While aiming, how many degrees the camera and her facing may differ before she turns.

settings.label: Modern Aim
settings.description: Aim where the camera looks: she turns with the camera while aiming and the gun follows it.

settings.label: Free Gun Elevation
settings.description: The gun follows the camera up and down instead of snapping to the game's three angles.

settings.label: Strafe Speed While Aiming
settings.description: File 1 roots her when she aims; the camera moves her with the left stick at this speed. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Turn to Camera
settings.description: Moving: she faces the direction you push relative to the camera. Always: she always faces where the camera looks.

settings.label: Turn Speed
settings.description: Degrees per second when the camera turns her.

settings.label: Own Turning
settings.description: File 2 only in the exe (its heading freeze); File 1 has none, so this changes nothing - as in the exe.

settings.label: Follow Hold
settings.description: Seconds she counts as still moving after her last step (the follow heading).

settings.label: Camera Side
settings.description: Where Keep Behind, snap and recenter put the camera (the exe's follow_dir 1 / -1).

settings.label: Yaw Offset
settings.description: Degrees added to the follow and snap direction.

settings.label: Shoulder Swap Speed
settings.description: How quickly the camera slides to the other shoulder.

settings.label: Recenter Time
settings.description: Seconds the Recenter button eases the camera back.

settings.label: Camera Collision
settings.description: Pulls the camera in front of walls.

settings.label: Wall Margin
settings.description: How far in front of a wall the camera stops.

settings.label: Low Obstacle Height
settings.description: Walls whose top is below the look point plus this do not pull the camera in.

settings.label: Ignore Props
settings.description: Skip walls flagged as props. File 1's wall data has no prop flag, so this changes nothing - as in the exe.

settings.label: Collision Hold
settings.description: Seconds the camera stays pulled in after a wall clears.

settings.label: Collision Ease In
settings.description: 0 pulls in instantly; higher values ease in.

settings.label: Near Value
settings.description: The exe's near_clip, written to the camera block (0 keeps the game's). On this disc that word is the fixed camera's look distance, so it has no visible effect while the camera drives.

settings.label: Far Clip
settings.description: The projection's far plane. 0 keeps the game's (50,000). Larger values show nothing more: the game's scenes, sky included, lie within 50,000. Smaller values cut off distant scenery.

settings.label: Horizontal Scale
settings.description: The projection's horizontal scale (the game uses 1.33). 0 keeps the game's, and REO's widescreen setting.

settings.label: Match Room Cuts
settings.description: Borrows the room's fixed camera nearest the view, so the game draws what that angle needs.

settings.label: Cut Match Max Cuts
settings.description: Rooms with more cuts than this are not matched.

settings.label: Show Hidden Objects
settings.description: Keeps objects the fixed camera would hide visible.

settings.label: Draw Distance
settings.description: Below 1: shrinks the radii within which the game hides models close to the camera, as the exe. It stops at 1: on this disc the exe's values above 1 only enlarge those radii, which hides nearby characters, and there is no farther view to open (the game's scenes, sky included, lie within its far plane).

settings.label: Hold Camera Through Doors
settings.description: When the game moves the camera (doors, scripted shots), take it back.

settings.label: Yield During Cutscenes
settings.description: Hand the camera back while the game runs its own cinematic instead of fighting it; returns when you move again.

settings.label: Cutscene Detection Window
settings.description: Seconds.

settings.label: Resume Delay (ms)
settings.description: How long the stick must rest before moving resumes the camera.

settings.label: Move Confirm (ms)
settings.description: A dormant value of the exe: it is defined but never read, so it changes nothing.

settings.label: Sprint Mode
settings.description: Toggle stops when you stop moving.

settings.label: Right Stick Only Moves the Camera
settings.description: The right stick is the game's ad-lib control. On, the game sees it centred, so looking around does not trigger ad-libs (not on Keyboard & Mouse, as the exe).

settings.label: Seat Detection Wait
settings.description: The exe's online seat detection (which character is yours). REO knows the local player, so this changes nothing.

settings.label: Animated Reload
settings.description: The reload uses the game's own combine routine and animation. Off: no reload (this exe version has no other reload).

settings.label: Crosshair Offset X
settings.description: Pixels, + = right.

settings.label: Crosshair Offset Y
settings.description: Pixels, - = up.

settings.label: Reveal Camera
settings.description: A capture aid hidden in the exe: blends between the room's own fixed camera and this one.

settings.label: Reveal Speed
settings.description: Seconds for the reveal blend.

settings.label: Camera Event Log
settings.description: Write the camera's events ([evt] lines) into REO's log.
